about: Speakers and scripts for the dialogue box (tools/dialogue.mjs). Lines here are the sample dialogue from docs/design/story.md: placeholders, not the final script.

lines.text: Don't take the lift. The cables are intact. The thing beneath it isn't.
I wanted to know you were safe.
How are you reaching this channel?
Who gave you access to that channel?
Body restored. Personal effects retained. Thank you for your continued business.
Uplink established. Objective: find the shaft down out of this sector.
Sensors read a security unit near the shaft. Neutralize it.
The south door leads back to the lift. Meridian thanks you for your service.
